mentions.name: Open-source CNC router tech stack
mentions.description: This project operates a CNC router (a robotic drill that carves 3D shapes into wood) entirely through an open-source tech stack: Inkscape for 2D vector design, FreeCAD for 3D CAD/CAM, Kiri-moto to convert 2D/SVG designs into 3D shapes, and Universal G-Code Sender to import CAM designs and drive the machine via G-code. OBS and a set of webcams live-stream tool usage to PeerTube Live.
mentions.source_excerpt: I have a CNC router (robotic drill which can carve 3D shapes into wood). Last year I challenged myself to operate it completely through an open-source tech stack.
